svg.title: Privacy and Security: Protect Data at Every Step
svg.desc: Personal data in inputs, files and transcripts is redacted with PII detection, which masks card numbers and addresses before data reaches the model, logs or people, so they see only what they need. Outputs are filtered for personal data, because a model can leak data in its output. Around every step: restrict access with Microsoft Entra ID and least-privilege roles; collect only what you need and set retention rules up front; and prompts and completions sent to Foundry Models sold by Azure are not used to train the base models.
svg.text: Privacy and Security: Protect Data at Every Step
Redact before the model, a log or a person sees it; restrict, minimise and delete around it.
